The database schema named 'rschema_0270' contains four tables: Program, Staff, Program_Production, and Program_Review.
The Program table represents a collection of programs, with each program having a unique ID, a name, and a type. It also includes the broadcast start and end times and the duration of the program.
The Staff table contains information about the staff members. Each staff member has a unique ID, name, gender, contact number, and position.
The Program_Production table represents the production team for each program. It has a foreign key referencing the Staff table, indicating the ID of the production staff member. It also has a foreign key referencing the Program table, indicating the ID of the program. The working duration for the production team is also recorded.
The Program_Review table represents the review team for each program. It has a foreign key referencing the Staff table, indicating the ID of the reviewer. It also has a foreign key referencing the Program table, indicating the ID of the program. The working duration for the review team is also recorded. The review result and the working duration for the review team are also recorded.
All columns allow null values except for the Program_ID and Production_Staff_ID in the Program_Production table and Program_ID and Reviewer_ID in the Program_Review table. The primary keys are Program_ID in the Program and Staff tables, and (Program_ID, Production_Staff_ID) and (Program_ID, Reviewer_ID) in the Program_Production and Program_Review tables respectively. The foreign keys enforce referential integrity, ensuring that the referenced data exists in the referenced table.
gold_question:
Broadcast Television Company produces and broadcasts a variety of programs, encompassing news, entertainment, sports, and other content types. Each program has a unique program ID, name, type, broadcast time, and duration. To ensure the quality of the programs, the company employs multiple production staff responsible for planning, producing, and post-producing each program. Each production staff member may participate in the production of multiple programs, and multiple production staff members may be involved in the production process of each program.

Each time a program production is completed, in addition to recording the participating production staff, it is also necessary to record the production time, reviewers, and review results of the program. Reviewers are responsible for examining the content of the programs to ensure compliance and quality. The system must also support querying information about the programs and their production staff, as well as the review status of each program.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0270
CREATE TABLE `program` (
  `program_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `broadcast_start` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `broadcast_end` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`program_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `staff` (
  `staff_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gender` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_number` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`staff_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `program_production` (
  `program_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `production_staff_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `working_duration` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`program_id`, `production_staff_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `program_production_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`program_id`) REFERENCES `program` (`program_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `program_production_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`production_staff_id`) REFERENCES `staff` (`staff_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `program_review` (
  `program_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `reviewer_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `working_duration` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_result` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`program_id`, `reviewer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `program_review_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`program_id`) REFERENCES `program` (`program_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `program_review_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewer_id`) REFERENCES `staff` (`staff_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
